newsitem.title: USA: CBOT, CME extend joint talks for another year.
newsitem.headline: CBOT, CME extend joint talks for another year.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade and Chicago Mercantile Exchange have extended their joint strategic initiatives talks for at least another year, Merton Miller, executive director of the joint committee, said.
Miller, a Nobel Prize-winning economist, said he would stay as head of the committee.
"I will continue to serve as long as the exchanges want me to," he told Reuters.
The committee was formed in early 1996 to discuss merging back-office and operational divisions at the two exchanges.
Miller said the CBOT-CME joint committee would finalize a common order entry system by mid-December.

The results of the committee's study on the cost-savings benefits of a combined hardware system will be released in January, Miller said. The study is being conducted by an outside consultant. -Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
